projection: task_state binding current must compare the job with its approved final_brief artifact digest, not the execution snapshot digest; before publish current is pending, after publish it is published/current, after request_new_version the old version is history_only

results resource access: candidate asset is not downloadable before approval, preview equals download bytes after publish, refresh adds zero calls, old asset stays downloadable after a new requirement version starts
failure boundary: a hard quality rejection yields S09 blocked IMAGE_NOT_APPROVED, no version, no delivery, no publish/download action and no downloadable asset
